# Fake narrator script for the English e2e (apps/web/e2e/lingua-en.spec.ts), campaign en-mini, mode improvvisa.
# One block per turn, separated by «---»; the last one also applies to the turns after.
[narratore] Mara steps up to the counter. Hale wipes a mug and does not look up.
[png_keeper] Rooms are two silver a night. Pay first, travellers.
[narratore] Tobin, what do you do?
[invito] tutti
---
[narratore] Thunder rolls somewhere beyond the hills.
[orologio] o_storm
[png_guard] Nobody leaves before the rain stops.
[narratore] What do you do?
[invito] tutti
---
[narratore] The fire burns low and the room goes quiet. Hale finally looks at you.
[png_keeper] Ask your question, then. I have nothing to hide.
[narratore] What do you do?
[invito] tutti
